reference_mix: Arithmetic mean of within-edition eligible age/gender proportions; equal edition influence. Freeze for all omissions.
quantiles: Cumulative mass inversion; exact boundary averages current and next distinct duration. Same rule for raw and adjusted distributions; different from warehouse linear quartiles.
weather: Existing seven ERA5 hourly observations, 09:00-15:00 Europe/Berlin; median temperature at 52.5163,13.3777.
association: Pearson over 16 edition contexts; every whole-edition omission. Fixed reference mix.
year_sensitivity: Median pace only: Pearson of temperature and pace residuals after separate linear year fits over all 16 editions. Independently checked by partial-correlation formula.
limits: Exploratory research captures; broad bands retain within-band variation. No adjustment for training/ability, timing, capture completeness or all historical changes. No causal interpretation, p-values or predictions.
